mapper.select: SELECT /*LGVATT50040.retrieveOtLevel*/ ol.ot_level_id ,ol.time_and_attendance_yyyymm ,ol.shift_type_code ,ol.ot_level ,ol.lower_limit ,ol.upper_limit ,ol.ot_category ,ol.remark ,(select local_language_full_name from lgcom_user_m where application_user_id = ol.creation_user_id) as creation_user_id /* 등록자ID */ ,TO_CHAR(ol.creation_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') as creation_date /* 등록일자 */ FROM tb_att_ot_level ol WHERE ol.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} /* Session Parameter로 셋팅*/ AND ol.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = #{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm} ORDER BY ol.shift_type_code, ol.ot_level asc
